title: Deep Fire Update
description: A mod that makes the Nether even better!
body:
Dive into the Deep Fire update! A brand new mod that makes Nether even better! By ItzFedd.



This mod adds:

Pyrite Ore: find it in the Nether Wastes biome. Y: Min: 0 Max: 80
Sulphur Ore: find it in the Basalt Deltas biome. Y: Min: 0 Max: 90
Pyrite Crystal: craft it by combining a Pyrite Ore block, Sulphur and an Iron ingot in a smithing table
Pyrite Axe: craft it by combining a diamond axe, Pyrite Crystal and Sulphur in a smithing table
Pyrite Shield: craft it with the same crafting as the normal shield, but instead of the iron ingot put a Pyrite Crystal
New Achievements
Netherrack Bricks, Walls, Slabs and Stairs: craft them by putting netherrack in a stonecutter
Soul Magmablock: a blue magmablock, fin it in the Soul Sand Valley. Y: Min: 25 Max: 85
Red Diamond Ore: find it in the Nether Wastes and Basalt Deltas biomes. Y: Min: 30 Max: 100
Red Diamond: craft it by combining a Diamond, Red Diamond Ore Block and a Pyrite Crystal in a smithing table 
Red Diamond Block: craft it by putting 9 Red Diamonds in a crafting table
Red Diamond Armor & Weapons: craft them by putting a weapon/piece of armor, a Red Diamond and a Pyrite Crystal in a smithing table
